reviews.text: Allison and Vicki did a phenomenal job watching our two cats, dog, three chickens and fish. Our dog is getting older and we didn’t want to board him for a week so we decided to try Moonwalks. I was nervous as this was the first time our dog has ever stayed alone and one of our cats requires daily medication. Allison and Vicki kept us updated the whole time and did a wonderful job. When we mixed up our day of return, we reached out to Allison last minute to add in some extra visits. She responded very quickly and kept us from having an animal disaster! Your dependability and responsiveness is much appreciated. Thank you for helping us to feel comfortable the whole trip. It’s clear the animals really loved you guys! We will definitely use Moonwalks again!

We and our pup LOVE Moonwalks. Allison, Fedy, & Vicki came to our home to meet our pup and assess fit and tell us a bit about what to expect for their services.

Our pup doesn't do well in boarding facilities (anxiety) so we try to avoid whenever possible. So having Moonwalks stay with him when we're traveling is the perfect fit. We feel so comfortable leaving him in the care of Moonwalks team. Honestly - he's so spoiled after they stay that he pouts because he's not getting as much attention as they give him!!

Whether it's walking your dog when we have to go into the office or an overnight while we're out of town, Moonwalks is our go-to.

I love this company!!  I'm (we) are so happy we ran across these people on-line.   In January my 93 yr.old mother fell and broke her arm.   She was unable to walk her dog.   We hired Moonwalks to walk her dog 2x a day, for about 3 months.  They did a fantastic, above and beyond, job!  Very friendly, punctual, intelligent and trustworthy group!  Not only did they walk the dog, they checked on my mom also.  She even walked with them now and then.   I highly recommend this company, can't stress that enough.   I actually am going to be using them for cat sitting at my house, soon!

We recently used Moonwalks for pet sitting. Allison, Vicki, and Fedy came to our house to meet our German Shepherd Josie before our trip. We automatically could tell that they were very kind, animal loving souls. Most importantly Josie could sense it immediately too!  They did everything they said they would and went above and beyond with the reports and photos. Vicki, stayed overnight, several nights, and we could not wait to read her colorful updates and photos. Fedy walked Josie daily and gave us uplifting reports as well.  They left the house spotless and it looked exactly the same as when we left. We know Josie was well taken care of. We could not be happier with Moonwalks service. It is not easy finding someone like them. I can't recommend them enough. We will definitely use Moonwalks anytime we travel!!

Moonwalks Dog Walking has been absolutely wonderful. They provide such personalized service, are very flexible, and take such great care of our fur baby! The “visit notes” they leave each day are so genuine- you can tell they’ve spent quality time with our dog and really know her personality! Would highly recommend their services!

Allison, Vicki, and Fedy began walking our Boston Terrier, Chocco, a few months ago. They have been great communicators, on time, and easy to schedule with. All three of them came to our house meet Chocco when I first reached out to them which really helped me feel comfortable. The after visit report and picture always makes me laugh :) It’s so nice knowing Chocco can get out during the day and isn’t just waiting for us to get home.

This was my first time using a dog walking service, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience! The owners are wonderful and accommodating, the photos of my dog on his daily walk are literally the highlight of my day!
Our dogs love the care and attention they are given when they are being pet sit. They are so spoiled by the people at Moonwalks.
Have had excellent service, with them, walking both of my girls. Too large German shepherds.
